pokedexEntries.rb: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

pokedexEntries.ye: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6F degrees within 3,300 feet.

pokedexEntries.go: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

pokedexEntries.si: The MAGNEMITE are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinities.

pokedexEntries.cr: When many MAGNETON gather together, the resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.

pokedexEntries.ru: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.sa: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to electronics and precision instruments. Because of this, it is said that some towns warn people to keep this POKéMON inside a POKé BALL.

pokedexEntries.fr: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

pokedexEntries.lg: Formed by several MAGNEMITE linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

pokedexEntries.em: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

pokedexEntries.dp: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

pokedexEntries.pt: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.

pokedexEntries.hg: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

pokedexEntries.ss: The MAGNEMITE are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

pokedexEntries.bw: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.

pokedexEntries.x: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

pokedexEntries.y: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

pokedexEntries.or: Magneton emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.as: Magneton emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to electronics and precision instruments. Because of this, it is said that some towns warn people to keep this Pokémon inside a Poké Ball.

pokedexEntries.su: When three Magnemite link together, their brains also become one. They do not become three times more intelligent.

pokedexEntries.mo: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

pokedexEntries.us: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

pokedexEntries.um: When rain clouds form, many Magneton gather in high places to wait for lightning to strike.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon is constantly putting out a powerful magnetic force. Most computers go haywire when a Magneton approaches.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: A Magneton is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group of these Pokémon can set off a magnetic storm.

pokedexEntries.la: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

pokedexEntries.sc: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

pokedexEntries.vi: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
